architectural_notes: Project distribution relies on a local ZIP export script (frontend/delivery/export-zip.sh) rather than chat-hosted downloads.
known_issues: User reports provided project ZIP download links are not working and they currently have no local project files.

existing_features.title: Add a delivery script that gathers/copies the entire repository into a single local "project folder" so the user can place all program files into one directory on their computer in one command (excluding .git, node_modules, dist/build, .dfx, and existing exports).

Update the delivery documentation to clearly explain how to create the single project folder and (optionally) how to create the ZIP, including exact commands to run from the repository root and where the output will be located on disk.

Ensure the existing ZIP export continues to produce an archive that contains exactly one top-level folder with all program files, and that the console output is English-only (remove emoji-only cues if present).

new_feature_requests.summary: Provide a reliable way for the user to obtain all program files in a single project folder/ZIP (download link or export workflow)

projectName: Create a single local “project folder” export for all program files
